title: RIP Canva? Meet Kittl
subtitle: One place to design, generate, and mock up — without juggling apps.
intro: Your reel said “Rip canva this tool does it all!!” You saved Kittl.com pitched as an all-in-one replacement with AI, templates, text effects, and mockups in one spot.
takeaway: Kittl bundles AI generation, templates, text effects, and mockups in one window so you create faster, but test lock-in before you switch.

sections.heading: Analogy: a food truck instead of a big kitchen
sections.body:
Think of Kittl like a food truck made for fast graphics, while Canva is a big shared kitchen. You tell the truck what you want in words and it builds the plate right there.

That sets up why one truck might replace four stops.

sections.heading: Why does this exist? One window instead of four
sections.body:
Why does it exist? Kittl.com keeps you in one window. AI image generation means the tool draws a picture from your words. A customizable template is a ready-made layout you edit, text effects change how letters look, and mockup creation puts your design on a shirt to preview.

In your save, creator shraddha.dsgn shows doing all four in Kittl instead of jumping between apps. Saving those jumps is the win, but that win has a cost.

sections.heading: What can go wrong? Fast now, stuck later
sections.body:
What can go wrong? AI can misspell words or draw weird hands, templates can look same-y if everyone uses them, and your files may not move cleanly back to Canva.

So test one real poster on both Kittl.com and Canva before you switch.

steps.narration: You start with an idea or text prompt.
Kittl generates an image from your words.
You drop it into a template and add text effects.
You preview it on a shirt or poster mockup.
You export the final design to share.
